label: Drops at D1 after unrewarded S1; at D2 rises for S2 reached and S2-favoring belief.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Raw candidate value of unit 32 (timing alone R^2 0.85: high at D1, saturated near -1 at GO, rising over the episode at D2). Beyond timing: at D1 it is strongly lowered (about -0.6) when the previous trial reached S1 and was unrewarded (S2-unrewarded barely moves it; rewarded trials raise it about +0.2). At GO it is saturated and carries nothing. At D2 it is higher when the reached state is S2 and when the ideal-observer belief favors S2 (negative belief_lo), i.e. it signals S2 at D2. The free fit adds a D1 rewarded bonus, a D2 a2-choice term and a D2 negative effect of a previous reward (dev 0.80 vs short 0.64). All terms are observed at their steps (state is known at D2).

skeptic.revised_label: Drops at D1 after unrewarded S1 trials; at D2 higher when S2 is reached and S2 is believed good.
issues: The qualitative claims hold. In the profile, the D1 residual after unrewarded S1 trials is -0.585 / -0.664, after unrewarded S2 trials it is -0.01 / -0.10, and after rewarded trials it is +0.14 to +0.21. GO residuals are all below 0.025. At D2 the residual falls steadily across belief deciles, from +0.36 (S2 favoured) to -0.43 (S1 favoured).

A better short form exists. Using belief (the probability) instead of belief_lo (the log-odds) for the D2 term raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.635 to 0.714 (dev 0.724). The D2 effect looks roughly linear in probability and saturates in log-odds.

The terms are each needed. Dropping the belief term gives 0.370 and dropping the state term gives 0.422. Swapping (state == 2) for (action == 2) gives 0.586 with belief_lo and 0.651 with belief, so the reached state is the better cue. Using (prev_reward == 0) without the S1 condition gives 0.675, below the 0.714 of the S1-specific term.

Leftover error is moderate, with no large systematic class. Misses on the improved form: D2 after a2 S2 u is under-predicted by +0.27, D1 after rewarded trials by about +0.10 to +0.16 (the short form leaves out the reward bonus), and D1 after a2 S2 u is over-predicted by -0.15. The free fit's extra terms (D1 prev_reward, D2 action) cover most of these.
None of the terms uses a future variable. The reached state is shown at D2.

final_label: Drops at D1 after unrewarded S1 trials; at D2 higher when S2 is reached and S2 is believed good.
